skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Grasp the basic concepts of public finance, including the public sector, government role in the economy, and major tools of public financial policy.
Understand the role of government in public finance and its impact on the economy.
Comprehend fundamental tax concepts such as tax bases, tax rates, and tax structures.
Understand the nature and role of national budgets, including revenue and expenditure components.
Grasp the structure of the national budget system and decentralized budget management.
Understand the concept of budget balance, deficits, and their measurement, causes, impacts, and solutions.
Understand the concepts of public debt, national debt, and government debt, and learn about debt management principles and practices.
Develop research, analysis, and synthesis skills to address fundamental public finance issues.
Establish critical thinking skills to assess public finance issues.
Apply specialized knowledge of public finance and general economic principles to analyze current situations and propose solutions for public finance management issues.
Be proactive in learning, answering questions, choosing topics, gathering data, analyzing data, and presenting results.
